about: The last_user window's span, pinned for BOTH repos. miStudio's renderer (probe_monitor_render) calibrates over it and miLLM's probe_turns serves it; each repo builds these tokenizers and must return exactly expected_span. The span starts at the newest user message's OWN role header: a template preamble (BOS, injected system block) is never part of it. Byte-identical in miStudio and miLLM. A case may carry its own template; otherwise the top-level one applies.
template: <s> {% if messages[0]['role'] != 'system' %}<|system|> cutting knowledge date <|end|> {% endif %}{% for m in messages %}<|{{ m['role'] }}|> {{ m['content'] }} <|end|> {% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|assistant|> {% endif %}

cases.name: single user turn behind an injected preamble
multi-turn: only the newest user turn
